items.title: Opening the prayer
items.cue: "O Allah, put distance between me and my sins…"
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَايَ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
items.transliteration: Allaahumma baa'id baynee wabayna khataayaaya kamaa baa'adta baynal-mashriqi wal-maghrib, allaahumma naqqinee minal-khataayaa kamaa yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas, allaahummaghsil khataayaaya bil-maa'i wath-thalji wal-barad
items.translation: O Allah, put distance between me and my sins as You have put distance between the east and the west. O Allah, cleanse me of sins as a white garment is cleansed of dirt. O Allah, wash away my sins with water, snow and hail.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 744: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/1223

when: Silently, after the opening [[takbir]] and before the Fatihah
usage.evidence: Abu Hurayrah asked the Prophet ﷺ what he said in his silence between the takbir and the recitation, and he said this (al-Bukhari 744).

items.title: The qunut of witr
items.cue: The words the Prophet ﷺ taught his grandson to say in witr
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلَا يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، وَإِنَّهُ لَا يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
items.transliteration: Allaahummahdinee feeman hadayt, wa'aafinee feeman 'aafayt, watawallanee feeman tawallayt, wabaarik lee feemaa a'tayt, waqinee sharra maa qadayt, fa'innaka taqdee walaa yuqdaa 'alayk, wa'innahu laa yadhillu man waalayt, tabaarakta rabbanaa wata'aalayt
items.translation: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, grant me wellbeing among those You have granted wellbeing, take me into Your care among those You have taken into Your care, bless me in what You have given, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed. For You decree and none decrees over You, and none whom You befriend is ever humbled. Blessed are You, our Lord, and exalted.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sunan al-Tirmidhi, ed. Ahmad Shakir and others, hadith 464: https://shamela.ws/book/1435/824

items.title: Rising from bowing
items.cue: What is said on rising and once standing
items.translation: Allah hears the one who praises Him.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 789: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/1296

when: On rising from bowing, then once standing
usage.evidence: Abu Hurayrah describes the Prophet ﷺ saying "sami'a Allahu liman hamidah" as he raised his back from bowing, then, standing, "Rabbana laka al-hamd" (al-Bukhari 789).

variants.label: Then, once standing: "Our Lord, to You belongs the praise."

items.title: Bowing
items.translation: Glory to my Lord, the Mighty.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 772: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/1743

usage.evidence: Hudhayfah prayed with the Prophet ﷺ at night and heard him say this in his bowing (Muslim 772). The count of three comes in a narration of Ibn Mas'ud whose chain al-Tirmidhi says is not connected, so no count is given here.

items.title: Blessings on the Prophet ﷺ
items.cue: Blessings on the Prophet ﷺ, as Ka'b ibn Ujrah was taught them
items.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
items.transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa muhammadin wa'alaa aali muhammad, kamaa sallayta 'alaa ibraaheema wa'alaa aali ibraaheem, innaka hameedun majeed, allaahumma baarik 'alaa muhammadin wa'alaa aali muhammad, kamaa baarakta 'alaa ibraaheema wa'alaa aali ibraaheem, innaka hameedun majeed
items.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; You are Praiseworthy, Glorious.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 3370: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/5232

items.title: Glory be to You, O Allah
items.cue: The opening praise Umar said aloud to teach it
items.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، تَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
items.transliteration: Subhaanakallaahumma wabihamdik, tabaarakasmuka wata'aalaa jadduk, walaa ilaha ghayruk
items.translation: Glory be to You, O Allah, with Your praise. Blessed is Your name, exalted Your majesty, and there is no god but You.

gradings.in: Sahih Muslim, no. 399, as Umar's own practice

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 399: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/835

usage.evidence: Umar ibn al-Khattab used to say these words aloud [at the start of the prayer] (Muslim 399). It is cited here as Umar's practice. Al-Tirmidhi also relates it from the Prophet ﷺ (242, 243), says the chains of both narrations were criticised, and says most of the people of knowledge act on it.

items.title: Prostration
items.translation: Glory to my Lord, the Most High.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 772: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/1743

items.title: The testimony in the sitting
items.cue: At-tahiyyatu lillah, as Ibn Mas'ud was taught it
items.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
items.transliteration: At-tahiyyaatu lillaahi was-salawaatu wat-tayyibaat, as-salaamu 'alayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu warahmatullaahi wabarakaatuh, as-salaamu 'alaynaa wa'alaa 'ibaadillaahis-saaliheen, ashhadu an laa ilaha illallaah, wa'ashhadu anna muhammadan 'abduhu warasooluh
items.translation: All greetings are for Allah, and all prayers and all good things. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and His Messenger.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6265: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9385

usage.evidence: Ibn Mas'ud said the Prophet ﷺ taught him the tashahhud, his hand between the Prophet's hands, as he taught him a surah of the Quran (al-Bukhari 6265).
